rv.q: What lingers most about Soul Sacrifice is its joining of the personal with the political.
All of this adds up to some powerful theater at CASA 0101, with director Kenneth Castillo eliciting deeply felt performances from his entire cast...
This play is like an altar, one that pays homage to the voices, images, and feelings of the playwright’s childhood, although these elements sometimes get lost in its historical-educational messaging.

cn.t: Consuelo G. Flores's semi-autobiographical drama earns praise as a powerful family story set in 1970s East Los Angeles during the Vietnam War, with critics commending its emotional resonance and compelling portrayal of childhood innocence amid hardship.
